name: Starlink Constellation
description: Deploying a network of over 5,000 satellites to provide high-speed, low-latency internet access to every corner of the globe — from remote villages to maritime vessels.

name: Mars Colonization
description: The long-term vision to establish a self-sustaining city on Mars. Starship will carry the first crews, habitats, and life-support systems to the Red Planet.

name: Artemis Lunar Gateway
description: Building the Gateway — a small space station orbiting the Moon — to support sustainable lunar exploration and serve as a staging point for deep-space missions.

name: Crew Dragon ISS Missions
description: Regular crew rotation and cargo resupply missions to the International Space Station, demonstrating reliable human spaceflight capability.

name: Polaris Dawn
description: A multi-day orbital mission featuring the first commercial spacewalk, testing new EVA suits and advancing human spaceflight capabilities at higher altitudes.

name: Starship Orbital Refueling
description: Demonstrating in-orbit propellant transfer between Starship vehicles — a critical capability for any mission beyond low Earth orbit.
